date: Required. Month of the activity: YYYY-MM (e.g. 2024-03). Rows dated EXAMPLE are not imported.
facility_name: Required. Facility name exactly as in Manage Data (see the list).
process_type: Required. Process key from the list (e.g. combustion, flaring, tank_flashing).
fuel: Fuel or factor name from the list for this process. Tier 2: your saved custom factor name. Leave blank for Tier 3 methods without a factor (e.g. completions).
quantity: Required. Activity of the month as a plain number (no unit, no text).
unit: Required. Unit of quantity (see the list for this process). Write tonne or short_ton, never ton.
tier: 1 = catalog factor, 2 = custom factor or site HHV / density, 3 = engineering inputs. Not needed when you choose one tier for the whole file in the import wizard.
equipment_id: Your tag for the source (e.g. EQ-001). Recommended: keeps two sources apart in the same month.
group: Optional grouping for reports (e.g. Compressor Station A).
source_ref: Optional meter, survey or document reference.
c1: Methane mol % of the gas. (combustion, flaring)
co2_mol: CO2 mol % of the gas. (combustion, flaring)
n2_mol: Nitrogen mol % of the gas. (combustion, flaring)
combustion_efficiency: Flaring: % of carbon converted to CO2. Blank = 98 %. (flaring)
destruction_efficiency: Flaring: % of CH4 destroyed. Blank = 98 % (99.5 % enclosed_ground). (flaring)
tank_ch4_content: CH4 mol % of the flash gas. (tank_flashing, tank_working, tank_breathing)
tank_control_eff: % of the vapour recovered or destroyed. (tank_flashing, tank_working, tank_breathing)
tank_unit: Unit of the throughput. Blank = unit. (tank_flashing, tank_working, tank_breathing)
